title: Collision Evidence.jpg
author: Alan Stanton
sourceDescription:
9 May 2011. I took photos to report a badly damaged streetlight to Haringey's Street Lighting team.
It turned out they'd already inspected it and ordered a replacement. The column - opposite Coombes Croft Library - had been hit by a jaguar. 
═════════════════════════════════════
Haringey residents - and staff - can report streetlights that are damaged, out, or on  all the time. 
● 020 8489 1254  - 9am and 5pm Monday to Friday
● 0500 236 458 - Outside office hours
● Email : StreetLighting@haringey.gov.uk.
● On the Council's website  using the Report-a-Problem page.
